keywords: This room is spacious. Besides, it is near the station.
It is cold today. Also, the wind is strong.
He has experience. In addition, he speaks English.
restrictions: Often reinforces the same evaluation or argument.
mistake: Use a contrasting connector when the new point opposes the first.
